keeps.name: High Falls State Park Lakeside Campground
keeps.waterfront_evidence: OSM loop (way 270262235) matched to Esri imagery 2025-09-16 (LG03 0.34 m) and Wayback 2024-01-19 (WV02, leaf-off): the RV loop, sites 100-116, sits under pine canopy with its nearest (NW) leg ~70 m from High Falls Lake and its NE tip ~135 m; the six yurts, their meadow and a wooded shore strip lie between the pads and the water (2024 park map enlargement: yurts 1-6 on the lake side of the loop, sites 112-116 on its inside). No RV pad within the ~50 m bound, a used yurt strip and trees between, no confirmed sightline -> not waterfront. The earlier lakefront call read the yurts' open apron as the RV loop's. Above the dam (DEM 187 m vs ~177 m on the lake).
keeps.inclusion_evidence: gastateparks.reserveamerica.com parkId 530168 site catalog (read 2026-10-29): Campsite 100-116 'Campsite Electric', 'Driveway Entry: Back-In', 'Max Vehicle Length: 25', 30-amp and water; 104, 106 and 108 are '- Host' sites, leaving 14 public sites, every one taking a 23-ft rig. Park map 2024: 'Lakeside Camping Area' with its own 'Entrance to Lakeside Camping' north of High Falls Road, 1.4 km from the River Camping Area's sites.
keeps.note: The smaller of High Falls State Park's two camping areas: a wooded loop on its own entrance road north of High Falls Road, set back from 650-acre High Falls Lake behind the park's six yurts, with a campers-only dock on the lake. The River Campground, 1.4 km south below the falls, is a separate entry. The park posted (read 2026-10-29) that High Falls Lake will be lowered between November 1, 2026 and January 31, 2027. --Claude

sites.note: Sites 100-116, all back-ins listed for vehicles to 25 ft; 104, 106 and 108 are camp-host sites, leaving 14 public sites. The six yurts beside the loop are booked separately.

facilities.note: Restrooms, showers and laundry in the middle of the loop; the park's dump station is in the River Campground.

fees.note: $36 a night at every public site (30-amp with water).

adds.name: High Falls State Park River Campground
adds.waterfront_evidence: Below the High Falls dam on the Towaliga River (DEM 167 m at the campground vs ~177 m lake pool), so no lake value; judged on the river, ~30 m wide. Esri Wayback 2020-02-27 (WV03, leaf-off) at z18/z19 with OSM roads overlaid: the river-side sites on the east road sit 25-60 m from the bank behind a continuous wooded, partly evergreen band on a slope (DEM ~163 m at the road vs ~153 m at the river); Loops B-D lie farther inland; current Esri (2025-09) is canopy over all of it. No pad within a pad-depth of the water, no open apron, no confirmed sightline; the 2024 park map is 'Not Drawn to Scale' -> not waterfront.
adds.inclusion_evidence: gastateparks.reserveamerica.com parkId 530168 site catalog (read 2026-10-29): Campsite 01-89 'Campsite Electric' with water, 30/50-amp; 31 and 33 are '- Host' sites, leaving 87 public sites; 'Max Vehicle Length' 50 ft at all but 32 (45) and 52 (15), so 86 take a 23-ft rig; 19 are pull-throughs. Park map 2024: 'River Camping Area' (Loops A-D) with its own entrance and exit gates on a road south of High Falls Road; park page: '1 in the River Campground C Loop for registered campers'.
adds.note: The larger of High Falls State Park's two camping areas: four wooded loops along the Towaliga River downstream of the dam and falls, reached by its own gated road south of High Falls Road, with a campers' playground in Loop C. The Lakeside Campground, 1.4 km north on High Falls Lake, is a separate entry. --Claude

sites.note: Sites 1-89; 31 and 33 are camp-host sites, leaving 87 public sites, 86 of which take a 23-ft rig (52 is listed at 15 ft, 32 at 45 ft, the rest at 50 ft). Pull-throughs: 10, 15, 18, 23, 38, 51, 65-71, 73, 80-84. 74 and 75 are buddy sites.

facilities.note: Restrooms, showers and laundry in Loops A, B/C and D; dump station on the exit road by Loop A.

fees.note: $36 a night for a back-in site, $40 for a pull-through.
